lines.text: I think, not I am thinking!
Many learners say: I am thinking you are right.
Better: I think you are right.
Think! I think it is a good idea.

data.wrong: I am thinking you are right.

quiz.stem: I ___ it is a good idea.

native.tip: Türkçede “düşünüyorum” deriz; fikir söylerken İngilizcede “I think” kullanılır.
native.caption: “I am thinking you are right” mi diyorsun? 😅 Türkçede “düşünüyorum” deriz; fikir söylerken İngilizcede “I think” kullanılır. Doğrusu “I think you are right.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “think”. Fikir söylerken I think de. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: For opinions, say “I think”: “I think you are right.”
en.caption: Do you say “I am thinking you are right”? 😅 To give an opinion, English uses “I think”. The right sentence is “I think you are right.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
